title: Gradient Mirage: Trainable yet Label-Unidentifiable Gradients in Large Language Model Split Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.18767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gradient matching attacks (GMAs) in LLM split learning (SL) rely on a critical yet underexplored assumption: the gradient exposed at the split interface is a faithful derivative of the client's full-label training objective. This gradient-objective consistency allows a curious server to recover private labels by searching for a sequence whose induced gradient explains the observation. We propose Gradient Mirage, a defense that breaks this consistency without discarding the optimization utility of the backward signal. Our key idea is to induce the adversary to solve a misspecified inverse problem, in which no plausible label sequence in the sequence space can explain the observed gradients. Concretely, Gradient Mirage achieves this by inducing inconsistency across three dimensions: objective, direction, and scale. translated_title: 梯度幻影：大型语言模型分割学习中可训练但标签不可识别的梯度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18767v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型分割学习中的梯度匹配攻击依赖于一个关键但未被充分探索的假设：分割接口处暴露的梯度是客户端全标签训练目标的忠实导数。这种梯度-目标一致性使得好奇的服务器能够通过搜索一个序列，其诱导梯度解释观察结果，从而恢复私有标签。我们提出梯度幻影，一种在不丢弃反向传播信号优化效用的前提下打破这种一致性的防御方法。我们的核心思想是诱导对手解决一个错误指定的逆问题，在该问题中，序列空间中没有任何合理的标签序列能解释观察到的梯度。具体来说，梯度幻影通过在三个维度上引入不一致性来实现这一点：目标、方向和尺度。选择性自回归监督从掩码替代损失而非全标签目标中导出暴露的梯度。
tldr: 本文提出“梯度幻影”防御方法，通过使分割接口处的梯度与客户端全标签训练目标不一致，在不损害优化效用的前提下，有效阻止梯度匹配攻击恢复私有标签。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Gradient Mirage," a defense that breaks gradient-objective consistency at the split interface without sacrificing optimization utility, effectively preventing gradient matching attacks from recovering private labels.
